name: Shipwright Shore
storyline:
The Marigold had five men aboard: a captain at the wheel, a man up the mast, a cook in the galley, a lookout who saw the
storm first, and Jonah Flint, who mopped. Nobody trusted him with more. Then a wall of black came over the sea, the rocks came up to meet the hull, and by morning the Marigold was gone. The sea let one man go. Jonah swam until he couldn't, and luckily he was good at floating. Now he has an island no chart has a name for, a beach where driftwood washes up every morning, and a plan: build a ship. The opening is sure he is the last of the crew. A logbook on a far island is less sure, and on an island farther still, something heavy is pointing out to sea.
summary: A blocky survival game with a way out: the ship you build yourself. Wash up on an island with empty hands, work from flint knives to iron, earn the islands beyond your own, and keep a castaway with opinions alive long enough to sail away. Fully offline. No ads, no accounts.
